summary: Earth is a planet filled with people and stories. Those stories may not be seen always but indeed can be heard. We are Planet Symphony, ears of earth! We are here to explore the changing patterns of Earth through its sounds. Our application, Earth Soundscape, allows users to experience the elements of nature spread across our planet through an entirely different perspective. By actively translating visual data into sound, we transform information into an experience that can be heard and explored. Through this approach, we aim to help people develop a deeper appreciation of Earth's natural systems, understand the changes taking place across our planet, and recognise the importance of the protecting our home.
details:
Planet Symphony – Listen to Our Living Planet

Planet Symphony is an interactive, Earth-science inspired project that brings together science, music, creativity and technology to make our planet's changing systems more engaging and accessible.

Inspired by NASA's Earth observations and scientific visualisations, the project explores different aspects of our planet, including atmospheric conditions, air quality, temperature, precipitation, wind, vegetation, water systems and wildfires.

At its heart, Planet Symphony explores the connection between visual scientific information and sound. It gives Earth science a creative dimension through topic inspired musical experiences and interactions, with each composition reflecting the character and atmosphere of a different environmental theme. Examples include Nitrogen Bloom, Ozone Chorus, Haze Requiem, Wildfire Pulse and Air Quality Nocturne.

The platform also brings together educational exploration and interactive experiences through sections such as Explore, Jukebox, Games and Frequencies, alongside progress related and accessibility features.

By combining environmental awareness with creative expression, Planet Symphony aims to encourage curiosity about Earth's natural systems and offer an alternative way to experience scientific information.

Our vision is To transform the way people connect with Earth science – turning information into inspiration and helping people experience our living planet through creativity.

Planet Symphony is an interactive project inspired by NASA Earth science that combines environmental visualisations, music and creative learning. It explores how scientific information about our planet can inspire unique musical experiences, educational activities and greater environmental awareness. By bringing together sound and technology, Planet Symphony offers a creative way to discover and connect with our living planet and reminds us of the amazing home that nature has given us.
